name: Technique Explainer
summary: Passive target-owned ordered explanation with a stable text core, optional target-composed details and media, meaningful native sequence, and no progress or workflow state.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named native section when a visible title is supplied; otherwise a generic container. Omitted when the required steps composition is absent or empty.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional header emitted only with a visible title.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible contextual heading and section label when supplied.

anatomy.name: sequence
anatomy.description: Native ordered list containing complete target-owned steps in meaningful source order.

anatomy.name: step
anatomy.description: Direct native list item containing one complete explanatory step.

anatomy.name: stepContent
anatomy.description: Text content wrapper that always precedes optional supporting media in DOM order.

anatomy.name: stepNumber
anatomy.description: Derived visible ordinal hidden from assistive technology because native ordered-list semantics already expose sequence.

anatomy.name: stepName
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible contextual heading for the step.

anatomy.name: stepDescription
anatomy.description: Required non-empty complete target-authored explanation with no clamping.

anatomy.name: stepDetails
anatomy.description: Optional bounded target-composed supporting content for applicable reviewed facts such as materials, duration, temperature or tools; it defines no universal record fields.

anatomy.name: stepMedia
anatomy.description: Optional supporting native figure or target media wrapper with context-appropriate alternative text.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Passive ordered editorial presentation; wide visual alternation never changes source order.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Container-responsive layout governed by the actual host width.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive document presentation with no current, complete, loading, selected, disabled, focus, or workflow state.

behavior.name: semanticRoot
attributes: aria-labelledby only when the visible title is present
behavior.description: A visible title produces a named native section; without a title the composition uses a generic div and emits no dangling label relationship.

behavior.name: nonEmptySequence
behavior.description: The required steps slot supplies at least one complete record with stable key, non-empty name, and non-empty description; otherwise the complete R3 root is omitted.

behavior.name: meaningfulOrder
behavior.description: Targets preserve meaningful authored step order as a native ordered list with direct list items. Visual layout never reorders list items.

behavior.name: derivedOrdinal
behavior.description: The optional visual ordinal derives from list position and is not duplicated as target record data; native list semantics remain the accessible source of sequence.

behavior.name: extensibleDetails
behavior.description: Each step keeps required name and description as its stable core and may compose target-specific reviewed details without converting possible materials, duration, temperature, tools or other facts into neutral fields. Safety warnings and precautions use separately reviewed rich content or canonical Alert composition, never an arbitrary untyped detail.

behavior.name: supportingMedia
behavior.description: Step text remains complete without media and always precedes media in DOM order. Informative media gets a truthful contextual alternative; decorative or redundant image media uses alt="".

behavior.name: containerResponsiveAlternation
behavior.description: Canonical CSS stacks content then media in narrow hosts and may alternate the supporting media side in wide hosts using the component container while preserving the same DOM and reading sequence.

behavior.name: passiveBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral R3 is not progress, navigation, selection, disclosure, task status, or a workflow controller and owns no interactive role, tabindex, current/completed state, event, or keyboard model.

behavior.name: targetOwnedContent
behavior.description: Targets own records, locale, revision, vocabulary, safety and factual review, media rights, alternatives, loading, mappings, and lifecycle; the neutral contract defines only durable composition.

behavior.name: zeroRuntime
behavior.description: The neutral component owns no listener, observer, timer, request, state store, progress update, navigation, persistence, announcement, analytics, or target service.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional visible contextual heading; its presence selects named-section semantics.

properties.name: steps
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned native ordered step composition. Every record has a stable name/description core and may compose optional reviewed details and contextual media; no workflow or universal process schema is implied.

accessibility: Use a contextual visible heading when R3 should be a document section; title-absent compositions remain generic and emit no broken label reference.
Render one native ordered list with direct native list items in meaningful authored source order.
Keep every step understandable through its required visible name and complete text; do not rely on image, alternating side, color, or decorative number.

Keep target-composed details inside the owning list item and give their internal structure its native semantics. Do not place safety warnings or precautions in an arbitrary untyped detail; use reviewed rich content or canonical Alert composition.
Treat the large visual number as a redundant derived ordinal and hide it from assistive technology while preserving native list semantics.
Keep text before optional media in DOM order and ensure visual alternation never suggests a conflicting step sequence.
Give informative media context-specific alternatives and decorative or fully redundant image media alt="".
Do not add progressbar, tab, disclosure, link, button, tabindex, aria-current, selected/completed state, roving focus, keyboard behavior, or live announcements to passive neutral R3.

web.notes: Conditional native section/div, ordered list/items, complete text, optional contextual media, named-container CSS, meaningful source order, and zero R3 JavaScript.

shopify.notes: Requires approved record source, editorial/safety review, section/block schema, order/limits, localization, media policy, and first template consumer.
